title: Xanthe and the Vow
author: C. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Freya Joubert, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
